editorial:
Imagine trying to fit into a world where you just do not belong. That is exactly what you get with Fishbaby#359478100 in this strange follow-up to the first movie. You will see Fishbaby trying hard to act like a normal person in a regular home, but things keep going wrong in the funniest and saddest ways. While that is happening, the Lesbian Dogwood is off doing her own thing, adding a totally different energy to the story. The whole vibe feels like a weird dream that you cannot wake up from, but you will not want to because the characters are so odd and interesting.

You will love how the acting feels real even when the plot is completely wild. The pacing is quick, so you never feel bored, though some of the plot jumps might leave you scratching your head at first. If you enjoy stories that feel a bit off-beat, you should definitely check this out.
endingExplained: Everything comes to a head when Fishbaby finally stops trying to be human and accepts their true self. The big twist happens when the Lesbian Dogwood reveals she was watching Fishbaby the whole time to make sure they did not fail. They both end up leaving the house together to find a place where they can actually be themselves. It wraps up with a hopeful feeling as they walk away from the fake life.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves strange stories about finding where you belong.
